public_message: We can offload 220 tonnes at Rs.180 per tonne, you pick it up.
private_reasoning: Opening high to test buyer's willingness; our true cost floor is Rs.70/t, but we need to avoid disposal cost of Rs.500/t. Offering Rs.180/t gives margin and signals seriousness while keeping buyer responsible for transport to shift cost. Expect negotiation to move toward a mid‑point.
